Plan: IntakeText logs the brief, IntakeVideo registers the source, VideoAnalysisAgent analyzes each reveal's buildup, HighlightAgent assembles the reveals into a highlight compilation. No SubtitleAgent because no captions were requested. No StyleTransferAgent or VideoExtendAgent because no look change or extension is requested.
